name: Base Battles 🔫 Gun Shooting
desc:
Welcome to Base Battles - a 20v20 action-packed vehicle shooter!
🔫 Experience multiplayer military combat 
🏃‍♂️ Spawn your vehicle and race to the objective! 
💰 Collect tokens by eliminating your enemies! 
🛩️ Expand your arsenal with new guns, cars, planes, and more! 
🤝 Team up with your friends to dominate the game! 

Make sure to join our server to catch sneak peeks of our updates and participate in limited codes! 
❗ Hear about new updates by pressing NOTIFY. On phone or tablet? Tap the 🔔!
👍 New Code at 375K Likes! 👍 
🔥 Make sure to leave a like and invite your friends to play! 🔥
